# Build Activity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:BuildActivity`](gmeow-BuildActivity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/BuildActivity>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

A software build process that transforms source code into one or more distribution artifacts. The build activity consumes a commit or repository and produces a concrete distribution (tarball, wheel, binary, container image). Aligned to SLSA provenance buildType and [PROV-O](../../external/ontologies.md#target-prov) [`Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md) by reference.
